summary: The 2026 Iran war (the US and Israel against Iran, since Feb 28) has heated up again after a tense pause: UKMTO reported a tanker attacked north of Oman's Khasab on Nov 17, Oman evacuated its crew with one Indian sailor reported missing, and a US military official told Reuters that US aircraft struck an IRGC missile launch site on Qeshm Island. Bahrain said it intercepted Iranian aerial attacks after Iran's Revolutionary Guards said they targeted a US radar system there, and Iran's and Oman's foreign ministers discussed keeping shipping routes open in Muscat, with no agreement announced.

status.label: Strait of Hormuz
status.note: Iran says it is closed to ships that don't coordinate with its Persian Gulf Strait Authority; the US says the main routes are controlled by the US and its regional partners. Most traffic moves through a shuttle system the US coordinates with Arab partners, with weekly volumes swinging as attacks continue (Al Jazeera).

status.label: Oil through Hormuz
status.note: About 11.6 million barrels a day over the seven days to Oct 13, about 68% of the 17.1 million pre-war baseline (Kpler, via Al Jazeera). This is the latest weekly figure found; no newer one had been confirmed by Nov 18.

status.label: The war
status.note: A US military official told Reuters that US fighter aircraft struck an IRGC missile launch site on Qeshm Island on Nov 17, after earlier limited US strikes there on Nov 2 and Nov 7 and on launchers at Bandar Lengeh and Sirik over Nov 15-16 (Euronews). On Nov 17 Iran's Revolutionary Guards said they targeted a US radar system in Bahrain with drones; Bahrain said it intercepted the attacks. Qatar, a mediator, called for restraint; no deal has been signed.

status.label: Brent crude
status.note: Brent rose 24 cents, or 0.3%, to US$92.22 a barrel by 01:18 GMT on Friday, Nov 20, after settling little changed on Thursday; it was on course for a weekly decline of about 3.5% (Reuters via Business Recorder; HDFC Sky).

updates.text: Reuters and CNBC reported that Houthi missiles fired at Riyadh raised supply concerns and lifted oil prices slightly early on Friday; no damage figures were given.
Bloomberg, carried by Insurance Journal and The Japan Times, reported that Iran stepped up attacks on tankers in and near the Strait of Hormuz just as oil prices slid.

Iran's Revolutionary Guards navy said two supertankers carrying more than 4 million barrels of crude in total hit naval mines and exploded on a "restricted route" through the Strait of Hormuz and were burning near its southern coast; it also claimed the tankers had US jet and drone support.
sources: Iran International – Iran's Guards say two supertankers hit mines, exploded in Strait of Hormuz

updates.text: Al Jazeera's Nov 19 live blog reported five tankers ablaze after hitting mines around the Strait of Hormuz, up from the three Iran's army had reported earlier; Trend News Agency also reported further mine explosions involving oil tankers, citing Iran.
sources: Al Jazeera: Iran war live, Nov 19
Trend: Iran reports further mine explosions involving oil tankers

updates.text: In a Fox News interview, President Trump said there was an "indication" Iran is pursuing biological weapons and said "we will see what happens after January 1" (Times of Israel live blog).
sources: Times of Israel live blog, Nov 19

updates.text: Al Jazeera, citing UKMTO, reported that a projectile struck an oil tanker in the Strait of Hormuz off Oman's coast; Iran's army said three oil tankers caught fire after hitting naval mines east of the strait. The Saudi-led coalition said it destroyed a ballistic missile launch platform in Saada, Yemen.
sources: Al Jazeera: Iran war live, Nov 19

updates.text: Iran fired at the Ali Al Salem air base in Kuwait early Wednesday; Kuwait said its air defences intercepted drones with no damage reported, and Bahrain issued shelter alerts and said it intercepted attacks (AP). The UAE condemned the attacks on Kuwait and Bahrain (Khaleej Times).
sources: AP via Spectrum News: Iran widens Gulf attacks

updates.text: The US Embassy in Bahrain issued a security alert for Americans there after at least four attempted Iranian strikes on Bahrain in a week (CBS News).

background: The war began on Feb 28, 2026 with US and Israeli strikes on Iran. An April ceasefire collapsed on July 8. The US has blockaded Iranian ports since April (reinstated in July); Iran restricts and attacks shipping through Hormuz, which carried about a fifth of the world's oil before the war.
factcheck: Checked by Claude against at least two reputable sources where possible. Statements by Iran's military, the US military (CENTCOM) or President Trump are labelled as claims, because each side's account of who controls the strait differs.
